target_customer: Retail crypto traders on Solana memecoins and Hyperliquid perpetuals
problem: Traders wanted faster token discovery and execution across chains without juggling bridges and several apps.
business_model: Trading fees on swaps and perpetuals

founders.name: Henry Zhang
previous_startups: Two startups built while at university, one exit (per YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: Launch post says he graduated in two years; school not named.

founders.name: Preston Ellis
previous_startups: One exit during undergraduate years (per YC launch post)

competitors.name: Photon
competitors.what: Solana memecoin trading terminal that the founders aimed to rival
competitors.traction_then: market leader among Solana trading bots per secondary sources

technical_complexity.rationale: Low-latency token discovery, wallet handling and trade routing on Solana and Hyperliquid APIs is hard in speed and reliability but built on public infrastructure.

defensibility.rationale: Traders switch terminals easily and competitors copy features; speed and a fee-rebate and referral network were the edges.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were overtaken in share according to secondary sources; the sources opened do not show any acquisition.

market_need_then: The 2024 to 2025 Solana memecoin boom created heavy retail trading demand; The Block reported in May 2025 that Axiom reached about $100M in revenue four months after launch.

branding.domain_note: Uses axiom.trade, not axiom.xyz or axiom.co.

identity.voice_and_tone: Trader-focused product copy; not examined in detail because the site returned 403.

branding.community_and_virality: Wide coverage in crypto press for the revenue growth (Blockworks, The Block, DL News) and later for insider trading allegations (February 2026).

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with a $20M-funded cryptographic proof company, but fast growth came from product speed and press about revenue; reputational damage came from the alleged insider misuse.

outcome_analysis: Axiom grew very fast on the 2025 Solana memecoin boom, with The Block reporting about $100M of revenue four months after launch and the founders saying they are profitable and not raising beyond the YC check. Risks are dependence on memecoin cycles, Hyperliquid and Solana infrastructure, and allegations from February 2026 that staff used internal wallet data to trade ahead of users, which are not independently confirmed.
notes: Sacra and Solana Compass report a $500K pre-seed from Y Combinator in March 2025 as the only outside capital; this is the YC standard deal and is not recorded as a round. A Lightspeed newsletter says the founders do not plan to raise more. Revenue figures (10M MRR, 100M total) are self-reported or reported by outlets without audit. Several funding results for other companies named Axiom were ignored. The company site and Blockworks returned 403. Competitor entries come from a secondary profile without precise dates.
